import os

    '$': 556, '#': 556, '*': 389, '+': 584,
}

    table = BOLD_WIDTHS if bold else WIDTHS
    total = sum(table.get(ch, 556) for ch in text)
    return total * size / 1000.0


def escape_pdf_text(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(path, pages):
    n = len(pages)
    page_nums = list(range(3, 3 + n))
    content_nums = list(range(3 + n, 3 + 2 * n))
    f1_num = 3 + 2 * n
    f2_num = f1_num + 1
    total_objs = f2_num

    objects = []
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    kids = " ".join(f"{p} 0 R" for p in page_nums)
    objects.append(f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {n} >>".encode())

    for i in range(n):
        objects.append(
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {LETTER_W} {LETTER_H}] "
            f"/Contents {content_nums[i]} 0 R /Resources << /Font << "
            f"/F1 {f1_num} 0 R /F2 {f2_num} 0 R >> >> >>".encode()
        )

    for lines in pages:
        stream = b""
        for ln in lines:
            font = "/F2" if ln.get("bold") else "/F1"
            size = ln["size"]
            txt = escape_pdf_text(ln["text"]).encode("latin-1", "replace").decode("latin-1")
            stream += (f"BT {font} {size} Tf 1 0 0 1 {ln['x']} {ln['y']} Tm "
                       f"({txt}) Tj ET\n").encode("latin-1")
        objects.append(f"<< /Length {len(stream)} >>\nstream\n".encode() + stream + b"endstream")

    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>")

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode() + obj + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {total_objs + 1}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += (f"trailer\n<< /Size {total_objs + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
            f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n").encode()

    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(out)
    print(f"  wrote {path} ({n} page{'s' if n != 1 else ''})")

    pages = []
    page1 = [
        {"text": "SAMPLE REPORT", "x": 72, "y": 700, "size": 20, "bold": True},
        {"text": "This sample report was generated because report.pdf was not", "x": 72, "y": 660, "size": 12},
        {"text": "present in the workspace. Replace it with the real report and", "x": 72, "y": 640, "size": 12},

    pages.append(page1)
    for sec in (2, 3, 4):
        lines = [{"text": f"Section {sec - 1}", "x": 72, "y": 700, "size": 16, "bold": True}]
        for i in range(12):
            lines.append({"text": f"Paragraph {i + 1}: Sample body text for the report contents...",
                          "x": 72, "y": 660 - i * 20, "size": 11})
        pages.append(lines)
    build_pdf("report.pdf", pages)


def main():
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Current date used on cover: {today}")

    if not os.path.exists("report.pdf"):
        make_sample_report()
    else:
        print("Using existing report.pdf")

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    title_size = 34.0
    title_x = (LETTER_W - text_width(title, title_size, bold=True)) / 2
    title_y = LETTER_H / 2 + 50.0

    date_size = 16.0
    date_x = (LETTER_W - text_width(today, date_size)) / 2
    date_y = title_y - 90.0

    cover_lines = [
        {"text": title, "x": title_x, "y": title_y, "size": title_size, "bold": True},
        {"text": today, "x": date_x, "y": date_y, "size": date_size},
    ]
    build_pdf("cover.pdf", [cover_lines])

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.append("cover.pdf")
    report_reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    print(f"Merged -> report_with_cover.pdf ({1 + len(report_reader.pages)} pages total)")

    check = PdfReader("report_with_cover.pdf")
    print(f"Verification: report_with_cover.pdf has {len(check.pages)} pages "
          f"(1 cover + {len(check.pages) - 1} report pages)")
    cover_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
    print("Cover page text:", " | ".join(cover_text.splitlines()) if cover_text else "(empty)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def escape_pdf_text(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(path, pages):
    """Build a minimal valid PDF. Object layout:
       1 Catalog, 2 Pages, 3..2+n Page objects, 3+n..2+2n content streams,
       2+2n+1 Helvetica, 2+2n+2 Helvetica-Bold."""
    n = len(pages)
    page_nums = list(range(3, 3 + n))
    content_nums = list(range(3 + n, 3 + 2 * n))
    f1_num = 3 + 2 * n
    f2_num = f1_num + 1
    total_objs = f2_num

    objects = []
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    kids = " ".join(str(p) + " 0 R" for p in page_nums)
    objects.append(("<< /Type /Pages /Kids [" + kids + "] /Count " + str(n) + " >>").encode())

    for i in range(n):
        objects.append(
            ("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 " + str(LETTER_W) + " " + str(LETTER_H) + "] "
             "/Contents " + str(content_nums[i]) + " 0 R /Resources << /Font << "
             "/F1 " + str(f1_num) + " 0 R /F2 " + str(f2_num) + " 0 R >> >> >>").encode()
        )

    for lines in pages:
        stream = b""
        for ln in lines:
            font = "/F2" if ln.get("bold") else "/F1"
            size = ln["size"]
            txt = escape_pdf_text(ln["text"]).encode("latin-1", "replace").decode("latin-1")
            line = ("BT " + font + " " + str(size) + " Tf 1 0 0 1 " + str(ln["x"]) + " " + str(ln["y"])
                    + " Tm (" + txt + ") Tj ET" + chr(10))
            stream += line.encode("latin-1")
        objects.append(("<< /Length " + str(len(stream)) + " >>" + chr(10) + "stream" + chr(10)).encode()
                       + stream + b"endstream")

    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>")

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4" + chr(10).encode() + b"%" + bytes([226, 227, 207, 211]) + chr(10).encode())
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += (str(i) + " 0 obj" + chr(10)).encode() + obj + (chr(10) + "endobj" + chr(10)).encode()

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref" + chr(10) + "0 " + str(total_objs + 1) + chr(10)).encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f " + chr(10).encode()
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        out += ("%010d" % off).encode() + b" 00000 n " + chr(10).encode()
    out += ("trailer" + chr(10) + "<< /Size " + str(total_objs + 1) + " /Root 1 0 R >>" + chr(10)
            + "startxref" + chr(10) + str(xref_pos) + chr(10) + "%%EOF" + chr(10)).encode()

    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(out)
    print("  wrote " + path + " (" + str(n) + " page" + ("s" if n != 1 else "") + ")")


def make_sample_report():

        {"text": "SAMPLE REPORT", "x": 72, "y": 700, "size": 20, "bold": True},

        for i in range(12):

                          "x": 72, "y": 660 - i * 20, "size": 11})
        pages.append(lines)
    build_pdf("report.pdf", pages)


def main():
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Current date used on cover: " + today)

    if not os.path.exists("report.pdf"):
